title: review: C-O6: daemon fixes from Phase A — count Claude fallback capacity in free_slots, and pick the review tier from the executor that wrote the code
spec: Why (gotchas.md 2026-09-18): (1) daemon.py:84 free_slots() sums idle parallelism over enabled, non-cooling Codex executors only; with every Codex row cooling it is 0 and dispatch() breaks before executor.start, so the on_exhausted=fallback_claude policy (executor.py:110) never fires from the daemon; T-0070 had to be dispatched by hand. Fix: when pool.cfg codex.on_exhausted == "fallback_claude" and the Codex sum is 0, return pool.cfg limits.max_parallel_claude_workers minus the number of running execute tasks with executor starting with "claude:" (bus.read(status="running", role="execute")). (2) daemon.py:168-171 gate() creates the review task without a tier, so it defaults to sonnet and a sonnet-executed fallback task is reviewed by sonnet (T-0071), against the never-review-own-output rule. Fix: read t.get("executor"); if it starts with "claude:sonnet" use tier "opus", if "claude:opus" use "sonnet", otherwise (Codex) keep the default; pass tier= to bus.create_task. Tests in tests/test_daemon.py: free_slots returns Claude capacity when all Codex rows cool under fallback policy and 0 under the hold policy; free_slots subtracts running claude executes; gate picks opus for a sonnet executor, sonnet for opus, default for codex (use the harness fixtures already used by the daemon tests; patch merge.TESTS_GREEN with a script that exits 0).
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py gains: free_slots_uses_claude_capacity_under_fallback, free_slots_zero_under_hold_policy, free_slots_subtracts_running_claude_executes, gate_review_tier_opus_for_sonnet_executor, gate_review_tier_sonnet_for_opus_executor, gate_review_tier_default_for_codex; all green

With pool.toml as committed (fallback_claude, max_parallel_claude_workers = 4) and every Codex executor cooling, `daemon --once` dispatches a queued complexity-3 execute task (observable: pipeline.dispatched_at stamped) in a test
Existing daemon tests unchanged and green; `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green
